title: SYCOPHANTIC ANCHORS: LOCALIZING AND QUANTIFYING USER AGREEMENT IN REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection and quantification of sycophancy—a behavioral bias where models agree with incorrect user suggestions—within reasoning traces. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks; rather, it uses a science question dataset (ARC) to study model alignment and reasoning commitment.
